name: Air Fryer Chicken Fajitas with Tortillas and Guacamole

components.name: Chicken Fajita Filling
steps: Combine raw chicken, pepper strips and onions with oil and all measured spices.

Heat the air fryer to 200 C and spread a portion of the fajita mix evenly without crowding; air fry approximately 15-18 minutes, shaking twice, until chicken reaches 74 C. Repeat for remaining filling.
Reheat fajita filling thoroughly and assemble in tortillas with the cold toppings just before eating.

components.name: Flour Tortillas
steps: Warm tortillas briefly only when ready to eat so they do not become wet in storage.

components.name: Guacamole & Sour Cream
steps: Divide cooked chicken and vegetable filling into four containers. Keep measured guacamole, sour cream and lime separately, chilled.

Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
